mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_family_member (family_id, user_id, role, approved, rejected, joined_at) VALUES (#{familyId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{approved}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT fm.*, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.phone FROM t_family_member fm LEFT JOIN t_user u ON fm.user_id = u.id WHERE fm.family_id = #{familyId} ORDER BY fm.joined_at ASC
SELECT * FROM t_family_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND family_id = #{familyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_family_member SET approved = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_family_member SET rejected = 1, approved = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_family_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND family_id = #{familyId}
